data.body:
FINAL PARENT STOCKTAKE after Gerrit 1817 and the >1s audit.

The measured objective is met for the newest three qualifying successful full routes: 22m47s, 26m14s, and 25m53s; mean 24m58s, median 25m53s, all within the 20-30 minute target. No individual pytest phase exceeded 30s. The former 57m29s failure is completely explained by 25m13s superseded-run admission plus a 30m23s macOS job; Gerrit 1792 fixed that cancellation dependency.

Ubuntu occupancy reductions and macOS critical-path reductions landed without removing behavioral/contractual coverage: coverage and complexity policy singleton routing, bridge cadence I/O hoist, AST provenance index, static Pandoc corpus with full real replay in External Integration, isolated repository templates, editor fixture removal, docs-only routing with all docs gates retained, build-provenance package fixture, and Gerrit 1817's exact 19-node repo_policy singleton. 1817 is merged as 53efe2426e and maize-wintery-larva is closed. Its specific post-merge organic delta remains N=0 because the newest tested patchsets predate the decorators; do not create a control run.

The complete audit is on closed puppylike-emo-rasbora: 403 local default phases and 73 integration phases >=1s, unioned with all selected CI top-25 observations into 501 normalized phase entries with family disposition and provenance. It confirms broad distributed macOS throughput rather than a single hidden long pole.

Approved next work is open but intentionally not started during this pause: songful-groovelike-horsemouse shortens only test-owned real-time windows while preserving production budgets and real process/lock/socket behavior. Research-only follow-ups are lead-unpleasing-kitten (grounding scan equivalence), reasonable-kingsize-polliwog (small protocol fixtures beside the required >100MiB guard), and rival-ammoniacal-crustacean (fault-seeded show regression equivalence).

Non-consensus residuals are no longer represented as active: panpsychic-clever-hawk and ravenous-beribboned-walleye are blocked with full reasons. The former has 4/4 direction-level OSS consensus but no safe implementation primitive; the latter retains its exact 24 real commit boundaries. The RAM-disk experiment remains reverted because all treatments were slower.

Back-out remains a normal Gerrit revert restoring the prior per-change execution; the scheduled External Integration corpus is the moved-boundary oracle. No new shard/job was added, so aggregate runner contention was not increased.
